# Searching for Logic — Adam Morton (vendored)

`searching-for-logic.docx` — "Searching for Logic" by **Adam Morton**, a complete
introductory logic textbook (≈115,000 words, 100+ tables, embedded figures).

Vendored here so the edot editor's **File ▸ Examples** menu can load it
same-origin: the author's site sends no CORS header, so a live cross-origin
fetch from GitHub Pages would be blocked.

- **Source:** <https://www.fernieroad.ca/a/> — "Searching for Logic (Morton) Nov 017.docx"
- **Author / rights holder:** Adam Morton — <https://www.fernieroad.ca/>
- **Status:** freely distributed by the author for educational use. Included
  here only as a demonstration document for the editor; all rights remain with
  the author. Remove on request.

It doubles as a real-world stress test of edot's `.docx` importer (tables,
figures, long-document performance). Referenced from
`magpie/edot/js/examples.js`.
